equipment.name: Adept of the Codex
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit may select one Space Marine trait they do not have to be under the effect of. Cannot select cursed founding, path of damnation, purity of all, expanded armory or sons of mars. Unique.

equipment.name: Helm of Censure
equipment.desc: The model gains 1 cumulative hit and wound re-roll. Unique.

equipment.name: Laurels of Victory
equipment.desc: Each wound the model does in combat counts as 2 for combat resolution.

equipment.name: Librarius pendant
equipment.desc: The model gains a +1 bonus to manifest powers from the Librarius discipline.

equipment.name: Sanctic halo
equipment.desc: The model gains a 4+ ward save and the "Aegis(4+)" ability.

equipment.name: Tyrannic War Veteran
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain +1 to wound rolls against Monstrous Infantry and Monstrous Creatures in melee.

equipment.name: Supply Vehicle
equipment.desc: Instead of using any of its weapons, this vehicle may use a "Stand & Shoot" command to grant a friendly Space Marine unit within 6" another use of any weapon or wargear item with the "Ammo(x)" ability.
